description: Change an agent inbox's `displayName`, its `label` (null takes it off) or whether it is `paused`. Send at least one. Pausing stops the inbox's replies, and mail to it keeps arriving: to stop mail arriving, delete the inbox. The address can't change: delete the inbox and create another. An inbox in another workspace, or one that was deleted, answers 404. The answer is the inbox as list_agent_inboxes describes it.

displayName.description: The name people see beside the address. Left out: made from the part before the @.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

label.description: A word or two to group and find inboxes, such as client-acme. Null takes it off.

paused.description: True pauses this inbox's replies. Mail to it still arrives. To stop mail arriving, delete the inbox.

name: update_agent_inbox
title: Update an agent inbox
